gaps.sentence: She left the room without ___ goodbye.
It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.
pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: When I was a student, I used ___ in shared flats.
gaps.explanation: used TO + infinitive = past habit/state: used to live. (Compare: be used to living.)
can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.

gaps.sentence: Would you like ___ now or later?
gaps.explanation: would like takes the to-infinitive: would like to eat.
